en: A black‑and‑white historical view of a European spa or resort town built on a hillside. In the foreground is a long row of ornate multi‑story townhouses and hotels with mansard roofs and many windows. One prominent building bears the sign "HOTEL NATIONAL" on its facade. Behind this row, on the ascending slope, stand several large villa‑like mansions with turrets and decorative gables, separated by terraced lawns and paths. In the far background is a wooded hill. The image has worn edges and looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
